1. Contents cover
Your household contents are insured up to 40,000 EUR in total at the insured address.
2. Valuables
Valuables (jewellery, watches) are covered up to 3,000 EUR per item without a valuation certificate.

3. Theft and burglary
Theft and burglary are covered when there is forced entry.
4. Making a claim
(a) Declare a theft to us within two working days of discovering it.
(b) File a police report and send us a copy.
(c) Provide proof of ownership and value for each item claimed: invoices, receipts, photos, warranty cards or
bank statements.
5. Water damage
Water damage is covered. Declare it to us within five working days of discovering it.
docs.Documents/Manuals/Veltra-55Q8_quick-star:
Veltra
1 Parc des Ateliers, 38000 Grenoble
Quick start guide
Veltra 55Q8 TV
Edition date: 01/06/2021
1. Remove the packaging and the protective film from the screen. Keep the box for any future move.
2. Place the TV on a stable stand, or fit the wall bracket as shown in the mounting guide.
3. Connect the power cable to the back of the TV, then to a wall socket.
4. Insert the two batteries into the remote control.
5. Connect your devices to the HDMI and USB ports on the back of the TV.
6. Press the power button on the remote control. The set-up wizard starts.
7. Choose your language, country and Wi-Fi network, then follow the on-screen steps.
8. When the wizard asks, check for a software update and let it install.
